summary: Allow a verified Packet20 restore to start a fresh session, preserve text capitalization and center text on integer pixels, and replace numeric palette entry with WLED named palette previews and confirmed Matrix readback.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing Packet20 snapshot/restore state machine, WLED 16.0.1 palette JSON API, native text overlay, and Matrix local controller; no new subsystem or dependency.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Offline diagnostic-session lifecycle, native text raster placement, and existing Matrix palette/touch controls.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert this branch's Packet20 RESTORED transition and adapter reuse path, native text helper edits, local UI palette control changes, tests, and this record; installed f89 is not changed.
tests: The nine HBNF control/release suites required by AGENTS.md

owner_design_gate.selected_option: Support normal capitalization and centered text; use descriptive named WLED palettes with visual previews and report whether Matrix state confirms application; provide touch controls at least 44 pixels high.
owner_design_gate.approval_reference: Direct owner instruction in Cart Upgrades project chat on 2026-10-11

evidence.performance_basis: Existing 28-profile f89 evidence reports high measured kernel work for Water (~39 ms), Distance_Experiment (~42 ms), and Complex_Kaleido_3 (~31 ms), with materially higher audio time for Water (~7.6 ms) and Complex_Kaleido_3 (~9.2 ms). Those mixed stage costs do not establish a safe visual-preserving code correction; no animation/audio code was changed.
evidence.qualification_boundary: Host/source tests only. The currently installed f89 image predates this lifecycle correction and still cannot be safely requalified without a new firmware candidate. No firmware was built or installed, and palette behavior, physical text placement, touch usability, DDP, Owner/Guest backend readiness, games integration, and final acceptance remain unverified.
